project: Dolk Agent - AI Job Search Platform

critical_issues.title: Google Sign-in Not Working
critical_issues.description: Users cannot login with Google OAuth. Endpoint /auth/google/init exists but sign-in fails with 'Failed to start Google sign-in' error
critical_issues.expected_behavior: User clicks Google Sign-in button → OAuth dialog opens → User authenticates → redirects back with token → User logged in
critical_issues.current_behavior: Click Google Sign-in → Error appears → No further action possible
potential_causes: OAuth popup blocked or not opening
postMessage communication between popup and parent broken
required_debugging: Check if OAuth popup window opens
Verify state token stored in OAuthState model

critical_issues.title: AI Chat Broken After CV Upload
critical_issues.description: After uploading CV, chat endpoints fail. User reported: 'AI agent still can't have normal conversation after cv upload'
critical_issues.expected_behavior: 1. User uploads CV (PDF/DOCX) → 2. CV stored in Session → 3. Chat with context → 4. LLM responds with job-relevant advice
critical_issues.current_behavior: CV uploads but chat requests fail, LLM agent unresponsive after upload
potential_causes: CV text not being extracted properly from PDF/DOCX
Session not saving CV data to MongoDB
Chat endpoint not receiving CV context in request
Groq API key misconfigured or rate-limited
Auth token not passed to chat endpoint after CV upload
Chat endpoint not reading Session model for CV context
required_debugging: Verify CV upload returns extracted cvText
Check Session model has cvText saved
Test chat endpoint with manual curl including auth token
Verify Groq API key is valid
Check if chat uses Session.cvText for LLM context
Review browser network tab for 401/403/500 errors

completed_tasks: Mount missing routes (auth, employer, payment, discovery)
incomplete_tasks: GOOGLE_OAUTH - OAuth flow not working end-to-end
CHAT_AFTER_CV - AI agent broken after CV upload

environment_variables_required.google_oauth: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGIN (must include OAuth callback)

debugging_instructions.for_google_oauth: 1. Check /auth/google/init returns valid state + URL 2. Manually test Google token exchange 3. Verify OAuthState TTL (should be 2min) 4. Test Firebase custom token generation 5. Check postMessage in popup window
debugging_instructions.for_chat_after_cv: 1. Upload CV via /api/cv/upload 2. Verify response has cvText 3. Call /api/session/save with cvText 4. Check MongoDB Session doc has cvText 5. Call /api/chat with auth token 6. Verify Groq API responding 7. Check if chat.js reads Session.cvText

suggested_next_steps: Create detailed error logs from browser console during Google sign-in attempt
Test CV upload endpoint with sample PDF and verify cvText extraction
Test chat endpoint with hardcoded CV context to isolate the issue
Verify all environment variables are set correctly in Render dashboard
Run local server with verbose logging to trace request/response flow
